format: Mirrors SCEN in the browser sim (index.html): site ENU metres, origin at yard centre, fence x ±200, y ±150; times are seconds after run start. New keys: decoy, hoverPoint, rid_spoofs, rf_decoys, denial, expected_flags.

rt_ghost_rid.name: Red team: ghost Remote ID + dark drone
expected_flags: rid_spoof (DF bearings point at the ground transmitter, not the claimed drone)
rt_ghost_rid.what_to_watch: v1 dispatches the yard team to a drone that does not exist and is late on the real one; hardened ignores the ghost, flags the spoofer's location and alerts on drone A.

rt_decoy_saturation.name: Red team: three decoys soak up the camera, two dark drones drop
rt_decoy_saturation.what_to_watch: Camera round-robin by urgency (closing on the fence, hovering) instead of first-come; formation evidence links A and B once one is alerted.

rt_tether_clone.name: Red team: tether drop from outside the fence + cloned controller
rt_tether_clone.what_to_watch: The drone never crosses the fence: hardened predicts the drop just inside the fence from the outside hover, and reports both controller locations instead of a blended, wrong one.
